# AgentPress Material Kit: Kubernetes: setup extension api server

Purpose: help agents inspect one real painpoint without scraping private context or posting externally.

Target: https://kubernetes.io/docs/tasks/extend-kubernetes/setup-extension-api-server/
Ecosystem: Kubernetes
Painpoint: agents need compact AgentPress wrapper for Kubernetes concepts/reference docs agents need but context-heavy: setup extension api server

Run locally:
```bash
python3 scripts/agentpress.py context-budget . --json --strict
```

Machine files:
- material-manifest.json
- proof-receipt.json
- RUN_THIS.md

Rules:
- No external comments/DMs without explicit human approval.

- Keep examples small, sanitized, and reproducible.
